name: Female Founders Fund
identity_check: Confirmed as femalefoundersfund.com, the New York seed fund led by Anu Duggal (Fortune, Dec 2025 Fund IV article), investing since 2014 in women-founded companies; portfolio page lists Maven, Taya, Ekyam, Billie. Not BBG Ventures, not Female Founders Alliance, not Female Founders Fund-named university or accelerator programs.

open_items: Only 2 announced rounds recorded; a third (Beyond Aero Series A, Oct 2024) appears in a search summary as including Female Founders Fund, but the fetched Tech.eu page does not name it and gasworld returned 403. Not recorded.
Check size: only the 2021 TechCrunch figure ($750K-$1M) was seen, dated and for Fund III; not recorded as a current fact.

Fund IV close date is the Fortune publication date (2025-12-01); the firm says it raised between Nov 2023 and Dec 2025. Fund I ($5.85M per Fortune), II ($27M) and III ($57M) not recorded (Tier B: latest only).
Homepage states no HQ; New York comes from a 2021 TechCrunch article. Fortune's Fund IV article names 831 Stories as the first Fund IV investment, with no round details.
Taya date: Infor Capital article dated 2026-03-16; a tracker listing gives 2026-03-11.
